surface: Android app code in the Flutter web preview (AUTH_MODE=api) against the real local backend

results.name: F1 protected screen while signed out → sign-in screen; the local note names the test code only because this is a local build
results.detail: LOCAL preview — no SMS is sent. Development code: 123456. 98765 43210 = existing customer.

results.name: F2 the app asked the backend for a code (public call, request id, no token)
F3 wrong code → refused by the backend (422) and the attempt count is shown
results.detail: Incorrect code. 4 attempts left. Didn't get it? Resend in 0:00

results.name: F4 correct code → signed in by the backend and returned to the screen that was requested (My Orders)
results.detail: Ongoing, completed and cancelled orders. Tap an order for the full snapshot, receipt or a reorder. Sort | Search by order number or restaurant | All | Ongoing |

results.name: F5 the access token is not stored in plain text (secure storage encrypts it; on Android this is the Keystore)
F6 session restore after an app restart: the stored session is validated with the backend (GET /auth/me with the token) and the customer stays signed in
results.detail: Ongoing, completed and cancelled orders. Tap an order for the full snapshot, receipt or a reorder. Sort | Search by orde

results.name: F7 profile shows the backend identity
F8 logout revokes the session on the backend and the app shows the signed-out state
F9 after logout a restart does not restore the session (no token is sent)
F10 a suspended customer is refused with a plain message
results.detail: This account cannot sign in right now. Please contact support. Didn't get it? Resend in 0:00
